title: Three separate tutorial systems fire at once on a first run, and the second one tells the user to do what they just did
summary: Two of the three causes were already closed in this shard's working tree and I revert-verified both: (a) FirstLaunchTourDao.getStatus() maps a MISSING progress row to notStarted rather than pending, so the replay-only coach-mark tour ('Three things to set up first: equipment, a profile, and a sequence') no longer auto-fires on a fresh install on top of the wizard that just did exactly that; (b) ContextualTourPrompt suppresses itself while that coach-mark overlay is mounted. The residue I closed is the one the repro actually lands on: 'Show me on the Sequencer screen' pops the walkthrough and navigates, and the Sequencer then raised its own 'Sequencer Tour — learn how to create and run automated imaging sequences' nudge, offering a tour of the screen the walkthrough step had just explained. Added a session-scoped guidedFlowActiveProvider that the first-night walkthrough claims on open and releases only on Done / Skip forever / Close — deliberately NOT on dispose, because a deep link parks the walkthrough rather than ending it. The prompt checks the flag before showing and hides (without spending the dismissal) if a walkthrough starts while it is already up.

title: The onboarding step list marks a step complete just for visiting it
summary: Already closed in this shard's working tree; I confirmed it by revert. _StepSidebar is now a ConsumerWidget taking the live draft, and a passed step is ticked only when `draft.producedValueFor(step, siteConfigured: ...)` is true — the same question the Review screen answers. Visited-but-empty steps (a guider whose PHD2 test failed and where nothing was selected) render a dash glyph instead of a filled blue tick, with tooltips 'Configured' / 'Skipped — nothing was set' / 'Current step' / 'Not reached yet'. The observing site is read from appSettingsProvider rather than the draft because it is a global observer setting, with null island (0,0) as the not-set sentinel. The redundant trailing optional-step dash is now only drawn ahead of the cursor, since behind it the leading indicator already answers.

title: The Tonight screen hedges about a fact it knows: "may be below your horizon or your location is not set"
summary: Confirmed real. tonightSuggestionsProvider (target_suggestion_provider.dart:100-104) returns an EMPTY list the moment latitude==0 && longitude==0 — before it looks at the sky — so oneTapTargetProvider hands the screen a null pick and the card blamed the horizon, the moon and the location at once, offering only a Refresh that can never succeed. The null-pick branch is now _NoPickCard, which reads the same appSettingsProvider the dashboard/planner/weather surfaces read: unset site -> 'Location not configured' + an 'Open Settings' button routed to /settings?section=location; configured site -> the honest 'Nothing imageable right now' with Refresh kept. The GO path had the same hedge (the controller's NoTonightTargetException default): the screen's pick seam now checks the site itself and throws a message that names it, and the exception's default text was narrowed to the genuinely ambiguous case.

title: "Unattended Autopilot" panel title is permanently truncated
summary: Confirmed real at the cited file, and the first fix for it was INCOMPLETE — I found the residual by measuring instead of trusting. The title was a single ellipsized Text inside a Flexible sharing a Row with the Idle/Running badge, so it rendered 'Unattended Aut…'. An earlier pass changed it to maxLines: 2 and proved that at a 1280 px window, where the panel is 358 px wide. But the panel width is clamp(available * 0.28, 280, 380), so every window from the desktop breakpoint (768) up to ~1170 px puts it on its 280 px FLOOR, and there the Row leaves the title exactly 100.0 logical px (measured: RenderParagraph constraints 0<=w<=100.0, didExceedMaxLines TRUE at text scale 1.0) — less than the word 'Unattended' needs, so two lines were not enough either and the title still clipped, now mid-word and without even an ellipsis. Fixed at the cause the finding itself named: the badge no longer competes for the title's line. The header Row is now Icon + Expanded(Wrap[title, badge]), so the badge stays beside the title while there is room and drops to its own run when there is not, handing the title the panel's full width (measured 214.6 px, didExceedMaxLines false). maxLines: 2 is kept with an explicit TextOverflow.ellipsis, because Flutter's default with maxLines set is TextOverflow.clip — a mid-glyph cut with no cue — which is the wrong way to fail at a very large system text scale.

title: PolarAlignmentNode cannot be added to a sequence - it is absent from the palette
summary: Confirmed real and objectively wrong: PolarAlignmentNode has a model (alignment_and_dome.dart:319), a properties editor (_motion_rich.dart:978), serialisation on both the file and repository paths, a time estimate, validation coverage, a registered Rust executor (native/skotiq_native/sequencer/src/node/registry.rs:114) and is emitted by SmartNightService - but no palette entry existed in any category, so the only way to get one into a sequence was to have Smart Night generate it or to hand-edit a file. Added a 'Polar Alignment' item to the Mount category next to Meridian Flip. Its isNorth follows the observer latitude the same way SmartNightService derives it (sequence_emitter.dart:310), so a southern-hemisphere operator does not silently get a node that rotates about the north celestial pole.

title: Palette search with no matches renders a completely blank panel
summary: Confirmed. Every palette surface fed rankNodePaletteMatches straight into a ListView.builder, so an empty result rendered zero children and the body went blank between the search field and the help tip - indistinguishable from a failed load. There are THREE such surfaces, not one: the toolbox Nodes tab (sequencer_screen_parts/node_palette.dart), and both branches of the standalone NodePalette (desktop sidebar + mobile add-node sheet). Added a shared NodePaletteEmptyState that names the query back ('No nodes match "polar"'), says what to try, and carries a working Clear search button; wired into all three.

title: UI scale dropdown truncates its own selected value to 'Extra Lar...' at large UI scale
summary: SettingsDropdown now measures its labels with a TextPainter at the ambient text scale and grows from the design width to fit the widest one, capped by the width the row actually offers (LayoutBuilder), so it can never trade an ellipsis for an overflow stripe. The widest label is used rather than the selected one so the control does not resize under the pointer. SkotiqDropdown gained `labelStyle` and `chromeWidth` constants and now paints with `labelStyle`, so the measurement and the painting cannot drift apart. Root cause: 'UI scale' is applied as a TEXT scaler in app.dart (_calculateUiScaleFactor -> combinedTextScale), so at 1.4x every label grows 40% inside a 140 px box that does not — the defect was latent for every SettingsDropdown, not just this row.

title: Enter does not submit the profile dialogs, so the fastest path through them is mouse-only
summary: Confirmed and fixed at the cause. Both profile dialogs are a single auto-focused, pre-filled TextField with no onSubmitted, so the focused field swallowed Return and the only way to commit was to leave the keyboard. Added textInputAction: TextInputAction.done + onSubmitted: (_) => _submit() to the Create dialog's name field (screen_shell.dart:777) and the Duplicate dialog's name field (screen_shell.dart:905). _submit is the same method the primary button calls, so nothing is bypassed: an empty/whitespace name is still refused with the inline error, and a duplicate name that collides with an existing profile is still rejected. The Create dialog's description field is deliberately untouched — it is maxLines: 2, where Return is a newline.
